description: Record the decision and document the new flow: edit ADR 0001 IN PLACE (do NOT create a new ADR), update SPEC.md §1/§2/§3/§6/§9/§10/§13, and rewrite docs/deployment.md, docs/secrets.md, docs/architecture.md for the Argo CD + ESO + backup flow. Ordered last because it describes the manifests, CI workflow, and placeholders that FEAT-001/002/003 create; it depends on all three being in their final shape.
steps: Edit docs/adr/0001-technology-choices.md IN PLACE (keep status 'Accepted'; do NOT add a new ADR): (a) in the Decision summary, change the Kustomize/SOPS line to add Argo CD GitOps and the SOPS->Secrets Manager->ESO secrets chain; (b) replace the Consequences bullet 'Deployment is a CI job, not GitOps…' with: deployment is Argo CD GitOps; secrets flow SOPS (git source of truth) -> AWS Secrets Manager (synced by the sync-secrets CI job) -> External Secrets Operator; (c) amend the self-contradictory 'Changing any choice in SPEC section 2 requires a new ADR and a SPEC update' bullet to permit in-place/superseding updates; (d) append a dated reversal note under Consequences using TODAY'S real date (do not fabricate) noting the deploy model reversed from CI-apply to Argo CD GitOps and the secrets runtime changed to SOPS->AWS Secrets Manager->ESO, updated in place per the amended policy.
SPEC.md §1: remove GitOps from non-goals; note GitOps via Argo CD is adopted (point at ADR 0001 and §10).

SPEC.md §2 table: add a GitOps controller = Argo CD row; change the Secrets row choice to 'SOPS (git source of truth) -> AWS Secrets Manager (synced by CI) -> External Secrets Operator'; keep the three-column format and the why-not-alternatives text.

SPEC.md §3: add to the repo-layout tree + infra list: deploy/argocd/ (Applications + ClusterSecretStore), per-overlay externalsecret.yaml, deploy/k8s/base/backup-cronjob.yaml + backup-serviceaccount.yaml, deploy/k8s/crd-schemas/, scripts/bootstrap_backups.py, the S3 backup bucket + backup CMK, and the daily backup CronJobs.

SPEC.md §6 table: kubeconform row notes the CRD schemas (Argo CD Application, ESO ExternalSecret/ClusterSecretStore) are validated via vendored schemas under deploy/k8s/crd-schemas/ fed with -schema-location.

SPEC.md §9: add the CI sync-to-Secrets-Manager step and ESO materialization; state SOPS stays the git source of truth; note the default Secrets Manager key is intentional (two-role isolation: CI write-only, ESO read-only) and the only CMK is for backups.

SPEC.md §10: replace the 'Deployment: a deploy job … applies the overlay' paragraph with Argo CD applies manifests (GitOps); the migration-Job-before-Deployment ordering is now an Argo CD PreSync hook; add the new sync-secrets workflow (own file, path-filtered, OIDC role + the extra secretsmanager:* IAM perms); note deploy.yml is removed. Keep the Datadog-at-deploy label note and the action-pinning note.

SPEC.md §13: mark Q3 (deploy target/GitOps-vs-CI) and Q4 (SOPS-vs-ESO) 'Decided — …' in the style item 9 uses, each pointing at ADR 0001; append to item 5 (left OPEN, not Decided) a note that the CI OIDC role now additionally needs secretsmanager:PutSecretValue, secretsmanager:CreateSecret, and secretsmanager:DescribeSecret scoped to arn:aws:secretsmanager:*:*:secret:k8s-fastapi-starter/*/app-secrets-*, on top of kms:Decrypt, cross-referencing §9/§10 and sync-secrets.yml.

Rewrite docs/deployment.md for GitOps: Argo CD replaces the CI apply job; the two Application manifests + ClusterSecretStore; the sync flow; the migration-Job PreSync hook; the sync-secrets workflow; bootstrap_backups.py and the backup CronJobs (backup image pinned-by-digest note); the break-glass manual `kubectl apply -k` note replacing the removed deploy.yml; the hard minimum ESO version floor v0.10.0 next to the 'ESO assumed pre-installed, cluster-level' note (must match the manifest apiVersion external-secrets.io/v1 and the vendored _v1.json filenames); and the two documented rough edges (first-env bootstrap ESO ordering; rotation doesn't restart pods).

Rewrite docs/secrets.md 'How it works' / 'Apply a secret' / 'Open questions': the chain is now SOPS (git) -> CI sync-secrets -> Secrets Manager -> ESO -> app-secrets Secret; mark Q4 decided (point at ADR 0001); document the rotation rough edge; flag the transient break-glass footgun (a manual sops decrypt | kubectl apply is overwritten by ESO's refreshInterval; real break-glass is pushing to Secrets Manager or editing the ExternalSecret); mention Reloader as a FUTURE option — do NOT add it.
Update docs/architecture.md: add Argo CD + ESO + the backup CronJob to the 'Kubernetes shape' / component description. No mkdocs.yml nav change (editing existing pages only).
Run uv run poe docs-build and confirm mkdocs build --strict passes.
acceptance_criteria: docs/adr/0001-technology-choices.md keeps status Accepted, has the three coordinated edits plus a dated reversal note using the real current date, and no new ADR file was created.
SPEC.md §1/§2/§3/§6/§9/§10/§13 reflect the adopted GitOps + ESO stack; §13 Q3/Q4 are marked Decided pointing at ADR 0001 and Q5 carries the new secretsmanager:* perms note (still open).

docs/deployment.md, docs/secrets.md, docs/architecture.md describe the Argo CD + ESO + backup flow, the ESO v0.10.0 floor, and the two rough edges; Reloader is mentioned only as a future option and not added.
uv run poe docs-build (mkdocs build --strict) exits 0.
verification: rg -n 'Decided' SPEC.md (confirm Q3/Q4 marked) and rg -n 'v0.10.0' docs/deployment.md
findings: DONE. ADR 0001 (docs/adr/0001-technology-choices.md) edited IN PLACE, status still 'Accepted', NO new ADR file created (docs/adr/ still holds only 0001 + 0002): (a) Decision summary 'Kustomize overlays, SOPS...' line rewritten to add Argo CD GitOps delivery and the SOPS -> AWS Secrets Manager -> ESO secrets chain; (b) the 'Deployment is a CI job, not GitOps' Consequences bullet replaced with the Argo CD GitOps + secrets-flow bullet; (c) the self-contradictory 'Changing any choice in SPEC section 2 requires a new ADR' bullet amended to permit 'updating this ADR (or adding a superseding one) and the SPEC'; (d) a dated reversal note appended under Consequences using TODAY'S real date 2026-10-21 (from `date +%Y-%m-%d`, not fabricated) noting the deploy-model reversal and secrets-runtime change, updated in place per the amended policy. SPEC.md edits: §1 removed the 'GitOps controller (Argo CD / Flux)' non-goal and added an adopted-GitOps note pointing at ADR 0001 and §10; §2 table Secrets row rewritten to 'SOPS (git source of truth) -> AWS Secrets Manager (synced by CI) -> External Secrets Operator' (kept why-not-alternatives text) and a new 'GitOps controller = Argo CD' row added; §3 repo-layout tree updated (deploy/argocd/ with the two Applications + clustersecretstore; base backup-cronjob.yaml + backup-serviceaccount.yaml + migration-job PreSync note; deploy/k8s/crd-schemas/ with the three canonical-cased JSON schemas + README; per-overlay externalsecret.yaml + BACKUP_PREFIX patch note; scripts/bootstrap_backups.py; .github/workflows deploy.yml line replaced with sync-secrets.yml) plus a new 'Cloud infrastructure this layout assumes' note (Argo CD + ESO cluster-level, Secrets Manager entries, S3 backup bucket + backup CMK + daily CronJobs); §6 kubeconform row notes the vendored CRD schemas fed via -schema-location; §9 added a new '9.1 SOPS -> AWS Secrets Manager -> ESO' subsection (CI sync step, ESO materialization, SOPS stays git source of truth, default-key/two-role isolation, backups-only CMK, transient break-glass); §10 added the sync-secrets.yml paragraph and replaced the 'Deployment: a deploy job...' paragraph with Argo CD GitOps + PreSync-hook ordering + sync-secrets + deploy.yml-removed (kept Datadog-at-deploy and action-pinning notes); §13 Q3 (item 3) and Q4 (item 4) marked 'Decided --' in the §13 item-9 style pointing at ADR 0001, and item 5 (LEFT OPEN, not Decided) got the appended secretsmanager:PutSecretValue/CreateSecret/DescribeSecret note scoped to arn:aws:secretsmanager:*:*:secret:k8s-fastapi-starter/*/app-secrets-* on top of kms:Decrypt, cross-referencing §9.1/§10/sync-secrets.yml. docs/deployment.md fully rewritten for GitOps (Argo CD Applications dev auto-sync / prod manual; ClusterSecretStore; sync flow; migration-Job PreSync hook; sync-secrets workflow; bootstrap_backups.py + backup CronJob with digest-pinned image note and the k8s-check --config/.kube-linter exclusions note; break-glass kubectl apply -k replacing deploy.yml; the ESO v0.10.0 floor stated next to the 'assumed pre-installed, cluster-level' note and tied to the manifest apiVersion + vendored _v1.json filenames; both rough edges: first-env bootstrap ESO ordering and rotation-doesn't-restart-pods). docs/secrets.md rewritten (chain SOPS(git) -> CI sync-secrets -> Secrets Manager -> ESO -> app-secrets; default-key/two-role note; edit/rotate via sops+commit; Q4 marked decided pointing at ADR 0001; rotation rough edge; transient break-glass footgun; Reloader named only as a FUTURE option, NOT added). docs/architecture.md 'Kubernetes shape' updated to add the backup CronJob + Argo CD + ESO + PreSync hook description. mkdocs.yml nav untouched. Reloader appears ONLY as a future option in docs/deployment.md and docs/secrets.md (not added as any dep/manifest). VERIFICATION: `uv run poe docs-build` (uvx mkdocs 1.6.1 + material 9.7.7, build --strict) exits 0, no warnings besides the unrelated MkDocs-2.0 vendor notice; `rg -n 'Decided' SPEC.md` shows Q3+Q4 (and the pre-existing Q9); `rg -n 'v0.10.0' docs/deployment.md` present; docs/adr/ confirmed to still contain only the two existing ADR files.
